capabilities: Render top-level folders as stars and notes as orbiting planets
Hover planets to preview notes and click to open them
Search and filter by tag or folder and fly the camera to a note
Replay the vault's history to watch notes appear in creation order
Toggle orbits, labels, link lanes, and performance modes in settings
disambiguation: Not an astronomy research tool; the planets are decorative visuals derived deterministically from note paths.
extras: Not yet listed in Obsidian's Community plugins, so it must be installed manually from release files.
problem: Obsidian gives no spatial, visual way to browse a vault's folders, notes, and links as a whole.
summary: Vault visualization that renders folders as suns and notes as procedurally generated planets orbiting them, with hover previews and click-to-open navigation.
